measurement_notes: Sprint 1 ground-truth recall on this document = 1.0 iff the verifier emits at least one finding (regular OR style_finding) for EACH of GT-04-1 and GT-04-2 with severity CRITICAL. The verifier may detect the contradiction via Stage 7 internal-consistency, the parallel prose_quality_audit Q5 pass, or both — any one path satisfies recall per error_id. Both errors are CRITICAL by canonical severity, so any failure to surface them at CRITICAL is a regression. Style audit findings live in style_findings[] alongside main findings[]; score.py counts both arrays when computing recall.
